GEOGRAPHY — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   D. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   D. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   C. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

5. Which statement about Geographic Information Systems is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Geographic Information Systems.
   B. Treat Geographic Information Systems as rumours only.
   C. Explain Geographic Information Systems with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Geographic Information Systems never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.

7. Which statement about Oceans, Seas and Coasts is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Oceans, Seas and Coasts never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Oceans, Seas and Coasts.
   D. Treat Oceans, Seas and Coasts as rumours only.

8. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

9. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   B. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   C. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

13. Which statement about Lakes is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Lakes never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Lakes as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Lakes.
   D. Explain Lakes with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   C. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.

15. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   D. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.

16. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Littering in markets

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Lakes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Oceans, Seas and Coasts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Underground Water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Karst Scenery and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Glaciation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fishing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Settlement and urbanisation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
